1. Publisher and free availability AETHER System Control ("the software") is a free, privately developed Windows tool by Olaf Weins. It is provided unmodified and free of charge.
2. Use at your own risk / mandatory rights remain unaffected The software reads system states and can trigger Windows maintenance and administration actions upon explicit confirmation. You use the software at your own risk. NO warranty is provided, whether for freedom from defects or fitness for a particular purpose. To the extent permitted by law, liability for indirect or consequential damage is excluded. Mandatory statutory rights (e.g. in cases of intent/gross negligence) remain unaffected.
3. Administrator privileges The cockpit requires administrator privileges for hardware access and system administration. Grant them only if the software comes from a trusted source. Back up important data before repairs; a restore point does not replace a backup.
4. Consent and data processing Guided changes require your confirmation. The free administrator console executes entered commands directly on Enter. Settings and local reports are stored under %LOCALAPPDATA%\AetherCockpit for the account running the software. AETHER has no general app telemetry. Standalone mode does not contact the management server. Optional client mode transmits diagnostic reports only after enrollment, manual approval and separate transmission opt-in. Network tools, updates and launched programs may contact their respective targets.
5. Diagnostics and privacy The initial inventory is displayed locally and can be saved as text. Inventories, events, backups and captures may contain names, device IDs and private paths. Review before sharing. Pattern-based redaction of text exports does not automatically apply to other reports or optional server transmission.
6. Third-party components The software uses LibreHardwareMonitor (MPL 2.0), smartmontools (GPL v2) and PresentMon (MIT) under their own terms. The included license and provenance notices continue to apply.
7. Desktop, capture and uninstallation Gadgets and enabled background diagnostics continue running after the main window is hidden. Exit completely using the tray. Logon startup and automatic capture require separate consent. Npcap is installed and licensed separately and is not included. Captures remain local and are limited to 128 bytes per packet, 100,000,000 bytes (100 MB) per file and 15 minutes. AETHER captures are removed after seven days during the next retention run. They may contain confidential data. Network alerts are indicators, not proof of attacks. After confirmation, the current uninstaller removes the installation and AETHER data for the account running it. Back up needed data outside these folders first; external files are retained.
8. Acceptance By accepting, you confirm that you have read and agree to the terms. Otherwise the software exits.
